title: recipe/assign-picker - assign one person to a small fixed set

review.applied: single feedback ingredient + inplace constraint (req 1); title/needs de-leaked of the token 'from' (req 2); convergence criterion rewritten (req 3); 'pick a person...' coverage kept (req 4)

problem: The sanctioned shape for assigning one person to a small fixed set (labelled native select + assign action + named feedback) is not described anywhere; agents composed it blind and could not cite it.
evidence: 4 independent runs converged on the same shape (native select + submit) under fallback/native-control (G-01)
c1 prop recipe/entity-picker and c3 prop recipe/assign-picker both requested a sanctioned composition
why_insufficient: A fallback + free-form composition leaves the need uncitable; the recipe formalises the recurring arrangement without adding any new visual language.

curation_recipe.title: Assign one person to a small fixed set
curation_recipe.summary: A labelled single-select (native select) beside one assign action; the outcome announces the new assignee by name.
needs: assign a reviewer to a request
assign an owner to a record
choose one reviewer in a fixed list
pick a person in a small fixed list
single select of a fixed set of options
choose an assignee for a record
constraints: native select for small fixed sets; component/cb only when the set is large or needs filtering
the control is always labelled and the submit announces the new value by name
if the assign is handled in place (fetch), the outcome uses recipe/feedback-inplace instead of the redirect banner

evidence.quote: Fallback/local solution used: fallback/native-control in all four runs - a token-conformant native <select> + submit button

compatibility: Additive; no semantics changed; does not affect component/cb queries; delete phrasings verified unchanged (title/needs de-leaked).

validation.g01_mapping: 7 -> component/select; #5 ('Choose one owner from a list of people') -> COMPOSE recipe/assign-picker; zero pattern/detail mis-routes
validation.ingredients: all ingredients resolve within the pack
validation.non_regression: combobox -> component/cb, date picker -> component/dp; delete battery (6 probes) -> entity-delete-armed

migration: The c1-c4 local <select> implementations become direct citations of this recipe; no markup change needed.
